mapper.delete: delete from gc_subject_association where master_id=#{masterId} and subject_id = #{subjectId}
mapper.update: update gc_subject_association set order = #{order} where master_id = #{masterId} and subject_id = #{subjectId}
mapper.select: select COALESCE(status, 0) from gc_subject_tag_association where master_id = #{masterId} and tag_id is null and "order" is null and package_status = 0
